common.four_at_most: Four computers at most at the same time.

profiles.max_sub: The best picture this device can show.
profiles.auto_sub: The best settings for this network and this device.

home.screens_as_is: The computer's own displays, as they are
home.screen_match: {width} × {height} display at {refresh} Hz, sized for this screen
home.screen_match_hdr: {width} × {height} display at {refresh} Hz, sized for this screen, in HDR
home.screens_many: {count} displays, sized for this device's screens
home.screens_many_hdr: {count} displays, sized for this device's screens, in HDR
home.add_computer: Add a computer or a console

add.title: Add a computer or a console
add.aside: Admin's QR code carries this same pairing link. Paste it here, or click it on this PC: KyberNow Link opens straight to adding the computer.
add.none_found: No computer announced yet. A computer running KyberNow Station announces itself on the local network; remotely (VPN), use the pairing link or the address.
add.compare: Compare the first four groups with the fingerprint shown in Admin, under Link devices. If it differs, stop here.
add.step1_after: , or the panel of its tray icon.
add.step3: Nothing else to type: this PC gets its own access, which you can remove from Admin.
add.account_hint: The computer's account (the one chosen at installation, or a device account). The password is stored in the Windows Credential Manager.

settings.custom_when: As soon as a setting differs from the profile.
settings.refresh_help: Match this display: this display's resolution and refresh rate. 4K at most: brought down to 3840 × 2160 if this display is larger.
settings.displays_help: Auto: all of this device's displays in Desktop and Max, one in Game and Custom. Each display gets a display on the computer, laid out the same way.
settings.displays_custom_help: With a custom resolution, the session takes a single display.
settings.custom_help: The computer's virtual display takes this size, whether the picture is larger or smaller than this display (it is scaled). Up to 7680 × 4320 (4096 wide in H.264, reduced if needed).
settings.virtual_help: The computer creates a display sized for this device during the session; its own displays switch off, then come back at the end.
settings.sharp_text_help: Full colour: text stays sharp, at the cost of a higher bitrate.
settings.wifi_warn: Above 300 Mbit/s, Wi-Fi networks often drop out.
settings.display_help: “Synced” shows each frame at the display's next refresh, without tearing. “Immediate” shows it as soon as it is decoded: a fraction of a millisecond less, with possible tearing; a G-SYNC or FreeSync display then keeps pace with the frames.
settings.keep_help: The last image of your session becomes this computer's background on the home screen, kept on this PC only.
settings.sound_help: Auto: as many channels as this PC's sound output. On the computer: the sound stays on its speakers.
settings.mouse_help: Auto: the game mouse when a full-screen game hides the pointer. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M switches between them during the session.
settings.keyboard_help: Ctrl+Alt+Del goes through the Keys menu of the session bar.
settings.transport_help: Fast suits your home network and gaming. Reliable resends what gets lost, at the cost of a little delay.
settings.reconnect_help: If the network drops during the session, the app reconnects on its own.
settings.wake_none: No address yet: connect to this computer once.
settings.wake_help: Turns the computer on remotely when it is asleep. It must also be allowed on the computer (Admin › System).
settings.keyboard_help_mac: With a Mac, the ⊞ key is ⌘, and Ctrl acts as ⌘ when the option is on (⊞ then becomes ⌃). ⌃⌘Q and ⌥⌘Esc go through the Keys menu of the session bar.
settings.immersive_help: Alt+Tab, the ⊞ key and the system's other shortcuts go to the computer. Ctrl+Alt+Shift + letter stays with the app.
settings.ctrl_command_help: Copy, paste and the Mac's other shortcuts with Ctrl, as on a PC. The ⊞ key becomes ⌃.

stats.help: The delay between the computer and this screen. Below a mark, the picture arrives before the next frame at that refresh rate.
stats.none: No session on this computer yet.
stats.capture_help: From capturing the frame to the start of its encoding
stats.encode_help: Frame compression by the computer's graphics card
stats.send_help: Packetising and sending over the network
stats.network_help: From leaving the computer to the full frame received here
stats.display_help: Rendering and waiting for the display's next refresh
stats.title: Statistics
stats.waiting: Statistics appear as soon as the picture arrives.
stats.lost_frames_help: Sent by the computer and never shown here: missing packets, or frames discarded while waiting for a keyframe.
stats.lost_packets_help: Packets lost on the network according to Kyber. Error correction recovers most of them without losing a frame.
stats.keyframes_help: Full frames requested again from the computer after a loss.

station.name: KyberNow Station
station.admin_help: Admin opens in your browser and asks for its password. The browser may warn about the certificate: the Station signs its own connection, this is expected.
station.restart_help: About 30 seconds. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.update_help: Version {version}. About a minute. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.requires_setup: Version {version} installs on the computer, with KyberNow-Station-Setup.exe.
station.too_soon: The Station has just restarted. Try again in a minute.
station.too_old: To restart or update the Station from this device, first update it from Admin.
station.offline: The computer is offline: the Station does not answer.
station.via_relay: Away from home, the app can neither restart nor update the Station.
station.in_session_restart: Restarting the Station will end its session.
station.in_session_update: The update will end its session.
station.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this device? You can add it again later.
station.slow_back: The Station is taking a while to come back. Open Admin to find out more.
station.update_failed: The update did not complete. Open Admin to find out more.

station_offer.banner_update: KyberNow Station {version} is available for this computer. About a minute.
station_offer.banner_setup: KyberNow Station {version} is available. It installs on the computer, with the installer.
station_offer.banner_away: KyberNow Station {version} is available. Away from home, the app can't update the Station: do it once you're back.
station_offer.notice_text_one: KyberNow Link is now {app}. Update the Station too: about a minute, a session in progress will be cut off.
station_offer.notice_title_many: Your Stations have an update too
station_offer.notice_text_many: KyberNow Link is now {app}. Update your computers too: about a minute each, a session in progress will be cut off.

appsheet.open_at_login_help: KyberNow Link starts with Windows, without a window: your computers wait for you in the notification area.
appsheet.help: Each version is verified before it installs: manifest signed by KyberNow, size and fingerprint of the installer. The app checks on its own at launch, then every 6 hours.
appsheet.probe_help: What this PC decodes, checked at launch by actually decoding a frame of each format. Profiles adjust to it on their own.
appsheet.battery_help: Save power: 30 Hz at most during sessions, with the bitrate lowered to match.

passage.slow: {name} is connected but not sending a picture. Its log often says why: in Admin, System › Logs.

bar.audio: Sound: {ms} ms to the output, {gaps} gaps filled this second
bar.mouse_help: Mouse: Auto switches to the game mouse when a game is full screen on the computer (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M switches)

share.title: Share {name}
share.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the link by hand.
share.help: On the same network: “Join with a code” in KyberNow Link, or this link in a browser.
share.help_relay: On the same network or elsewhere: “Join with a code” in KyberNow Link, or this link in a browser. Away from home, you accept each guest.
share.relay_down: Not reachable away from home yet.
share.waiting: Waiting for the host to accept…
share.join_help: The code of a share, a loan or an invitation.

fond.not_created: The computer could not create this display.

lend.code_valid: For one session, valid for 24 h.
lend.code_help: Your friend enters this code with “Join with a code” in KyberNow Link, or opens this link in a browser.
lend.session_closes: Your session will close when your friend arrives.
lend.trust: Your friend plays in your Windows session. They see neither your desktop nor your windows, but a game can read your files: lend to friends you trust.
lend.disabled: Lending is off in Admin (“Lending” page).
lend.unsupported: Lending needs KyberNow Station 0.9.0 or later.
lend.slot_notice: {name}'s time slot: the computer is lent to them in 2 min.
lend.come_back_hint: You can come back for 15 min.
lend.unavailable: Lending isn't possible on this computer.

invite.title: Add {name}
invite.help: This invitation adds the computer to your devices. Enter the password given with the code.

account.find_lead: With a KyberNow account, your computers and the ones opened to you show up here, wherever you are.
account.sign_in_help: The relay's page opens: password, passkey or two-factor authentication happen there, never in the app. No account yet: “Create an account” on that page.
account.section_help: Create an account, change its password or delete it: on the account's page.
account.sign_out_confirm: Sign out of {account}? Its computers leave this device; the ones you paired stay.
account.relay_help: Your account's relay address, if it isn't share.kybernow.app.

ps.format_auto_help: H.265 if this device can play it.
ps.fullscreen: Open the game in full screen
ps.controller_help: For the DualSense. HD haptics go through the controller plugged in over USB.
ps.controls_help: The keyboard and mouse stand in for a controller. A connected controller replaces them.
ps.mouse_stick: The mouse holds the right stick
ps.minimum_tilt_help: To get past games' dead zone.
ps.remove_console_confirm: Remove {name} from this device? You can pair it again later.
ps.stats_waiting: Statistics appear as soon as the picture arrives.
ps.rest: Put the console in rest mode
ps.pad_away: The console no longer receives it
ps.no_account: No account: add one to pair a console.
ps.remove_question_one: Remove the account {name} and its console?
ps.remove_question_other: Remove the account {name} and its {n} consoles?
ps.remove_help: Its pairings are erased from this device. A console also paired with another account stays, with that other account.
ps.no_console: No console found. Turn it on or put it in rest mode, or enter its address in “By address”.
ps.address_help: The address of a computer, or of a PlayStation console (through a VPN or from another network).
ps.sign_in_help: Sign in to the PlayStation Network account to pair. KyberNow only reads the account's ID and online ID, once.
ps.signing_in: Sign in in the PlayStation Network window…
ps.name_help: To recognise it in the list.
ps.code_help: On the console: Settings › System › Remote Play › Link Device. Enter the code shown.
ps.no_device: No device waiting. On the TV or the other device: Add a console › Receive from another device.
ps.receive_help: On your Mac, PC or phone: Add a computer or a console › PlayStation › Send to a device, then enter this code.

hdr.help: Richer colours and brighter highlights, on this HDR screen.
hdr.settings_help: Richer colours and brighter highlights, on this HDR screen. Sharp text (4:4:4) doesn't exist in HDR.

pyrowave.chosen_help: Almost no compression delay, but 5 to 10 times the bitrate of HEVC. Made for an Ethernet cable.
pyrowave.auto_wired: Auto: PyroWave, because this device is connected by cable. Otherwise HEVC.
pyrowave.auto_unwired: Auto: HEVC. PyroWave is only used when this device is connected by cable.
pyrowave.auto_profile_only: Auto: HEVC. PyroWave is used by Max and Auto, when this device is connected by cable.
pyrowave.warn_wifi: On Wi-Fi, PyroWave may stutter: it needs about 300 Mbit/s at 1080p. Keep “Auto” if you're not sure.
pyrowave.warn_relay: Away from home, PyroWave goes through the relay and your internet connection: the picture may stutter. Keep “Auto” if you're not sure.
pyrowave.lowered: Resolution lowered to {w} × {h} to fit in {n} Mbit/s.
pyrowave.sharp_text_help: With PyroWave, almost free: only the bitrate goes up.

autotest.title: Auto profile
autotest.subtitle: KyberNow measures your network and this device, then suggests the best settings.
autotest.later: The test will run when the session ends.
autotest.adaptive_help: Lowers the bitrate when the network is saturated, then raises it again. Off, the bitrate never moves.
autotest.adaptive_pyrowave: With PyroWave it pauses: the resolution goes down instead.

welcome.s1_title: Your computer, on all your devices
welcome.s1_text: Play, work and get back to your desktop from another screen, as if you were sitting in front of it.
welcome.s2_title: With an account, everything follows you
welcome.s2_text: A KyberNow account, and your computers wait for you everywhere.
welcome.away_text: Reach your computer from anywhere, with nothing to set up on your router.
welcome.devices_text: Your computers show up by themselves wherever you sign in.
welcome.share_text: Invite a friend to play, lend your PC, open it to your family or your team.
welcome.settings_text: Profile, format and bitrate follow you from one device to another.
welcome.s2_help: {relay}'s page opens: your password never goes through the app.
welcome.sign_up_notice: Create your account in the browser, then come back here: “Connect an account”.
welcome.s3_text: Install KyberNow Station on the computer you want to reach: on the same network, it shows up here by itself. A friend gave you a code? Enter it.
welcome.code_text: A friend opens their computer to you: enter the code they gave you.
welcome.not_installed_text: Download KyberNow Station on the computer you want to reach.
welcome.card_text: On all your devices, even away from home.
welcome.away_dialog_text: {name} isn't on this network. To reach it from where you are, connect a KyberNow account: your computer follows you everywhere, with nothing to set up on your router.
welcome.paired_text: Find it away from home and on your other devices too: connect a KyberNow account.

micro.setting_help: Sends this device's microphone to the computer during the session, to talk in a game, a call or a video meeting.
micro.echo_help: The device's voice processing removes the computer's sound and the noise around you. Turn it off for a studio microphone.
micro.guests_help: Their microphone reaches the computer, for a game or a call.

camera.resolution_help: 30 frames per second. In 1080p, the camera needs about 4 Mbit/s towards the computer.
